description: How the island shows one thing going on: a widget's items on the two sides of its compact form and in its open panel, and when it shows. Nothing in it runs: its words name things the program already knows, each button does one action from a closed list, and its pictures come from the activity's own folder.

aura.description: A glow round the island. An activity may carry this alone. Version 2.

colour.description: The glow's colour: the island's own, the accent, the cover of what plays, or light.

events.description: Lighting up when something happens: a picture saved, a download done, a device come, the next piece.

music.description: Breathing with how loud what plays is.

compact.description: The island's small form, the pill: its leading side, its middle and its trailing side, each a widget's items.

height.description: How tall the compact form stands while this look shows, in points. Version 2.

family.description: The type every word in it is set in, unless a text item names its own. Left out, the island's own.

jelly.description: The island giving and springing back. An activity may carry this alone. Version 2.

arrive.description: When something new comes onto it.

open.description: When it opens, closes, or goes from one form to another.

knobs.description: The settings a subscriber may turn on the item's card, within the author's limits; at most 8. Each names a field of this same file by a JSON pointer and is checked by writing its limits (or each choice) into the file and reading it back: a knob whose field the item does not keep, or whose limits the format would change on reading, refuses the whole item. The person's values are kept beside the item, so an update from its author still arrives.

default.description: What the author's file has at the path, as the program writes it into a saved file. Ignored on reading.

id.description: Stable across the item's updates: what the person's value is kept by. Lower-case letters, digits and dashes.

label.description: What the setting is called on the card. One text, or one per language by Steam's language codes ({"english": "Corners", "german": "Ecken"}); a language the program does not speak is left out. Cut to 40 characters.

min.description: number: the least it goes to.

options.description: choice: the values offered, each with its label.

label.description: What the value is called. One text, or one per language by Steam's language codes ({"english": "Corners", "german": "Ecken"}); a language the program does not speak is left out. Cut to 40 characters.

value.description: A word of at most 64 characters, a number or a switch.

path.description: A JSON pointer (RFC 6901) into this file, such as "/dock/radius" or "/minimize/duration_ms", at most 10 steps deep. It may not name the item's $schema, version, name, about, knobs, files, hotspots.

step.description: number: the steps it moves on from min, 0 for any value; no larger than max - min.

type.description: number: a value between min and max; colour: one of choices; choice: one of options. A type this version does not know is left out, not the item.

unit.description: number: what it counts, written beside it in the person's language.

look.description: The name of the file's own look, when it carries others. Version 2.

looks.description: Other ways the activity may look, each picked on the Island page. Version 2.

compact.description: The island's small form, the pill: its leading side, its middle and its trailing side, each a widget's items.

height.description: How tall the compact form stands while this look shows, in points. Version 2.
